dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature (falcate), with the spline transitioning from a high-gradient negative slope at the apex to a shallower curve at the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification; the vertex is slightly rounded with a small pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep convex anterior margin, oriented at approximately 55 degrees relative to the visible horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 vertical height to base width ratio.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple fine linear parallel scars (tooth rakes) are visible on the lower left lateral flank; several small, irregular white depigmented spots are scattered across the mid-body.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent light-colored, broad lateral patch or highlight is visible on the flank directly below the dorsal fin.
